title: Qwen3, voice design

settings.instruct: A bright, upbeat young American woman, morning radio DJ, warm and playful, fast casual delivery, smiles while talking, laughs easily, gets excited on exclamations.

tricks: The voice is designed from a written description, because the stock voices have no native English female
One description covers the whole paragraph

why: Qwen3's voice-design checkpoint asked for an upbeat American woman, since its stock female voices all carry an accent in English.
